more_info.overview: Beetroot Red is used as a color in food. Its technological role is to add or restore food colour.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include dried fruit and vegetables, fruit and vegetables in vinegar oil or brine, canned or bottled fruit and vegetables, fruit and vegetable preparations excluding compote. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Red beet roots are pressed or extracted with water, then the coloured material is concentrated or refined. Betanin is the main red pigment.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The specified starting material is plant derived and compatible with vegetarian and vegan diets. The specification does not establish halal or kosher certification.
